parameters.query:
-- Everything the AI needs to understand the business. #1 = business id
select to_jsonb(b) as business,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select name, price, currency, left(description, 80) as description
       from products where business_id = b.id and active
      order by created_at desc limit 15) x) as products,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select id, platform, external_id
       from social_accounts
      where business_id = b.id and enabled and status = 'connected') x) as accounts,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(left(r.caption, 140)), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select caption from posts
      where business_id = b.id and caption is not null
      order by created_at desc limit 3) r) as recent
from (select id, name, category, country, languages, brand, brand_brief
        from businesses where id = $1::uuid) b;

-- Save the image + post and count usage. The post takes the first free (date, slot) from today.
-- #1 business, #2 storage path, #3 bytes, #4 alt text, #5 caption, #6 variants, #7 brief,
-- #8 status ('publishing' or 'ready'), #9 image cost, #10 text cost
with m as (
  insert into media (business_id, kind, source, storage_path, bytes, description)
  values ($1::uuid, 'photo', 'ai', $2, $3::int, $4)
  returning id
), s as (
  select (now() at time zone b.timezone)::date + d as local_date, sl::smallint as slot
    from businesses b, generate_series(0, 60) d, generate_series(1, 3) sl
   where b.id = $1::uuid
     and not exists (select 1 from posts x
                      where x.business_id = $1::uuid and not x.is_story and x.slot = sl
                        and x.local_date = (now() at time zone b.timezone)::date + d)
   order by 1, 2
   limit 1
), u1 as (select bump_usage($1::uuid, 'images', 1, $9::numeric)),
   u2 as (select bump_usage($1::uuid, 'text_calls', 1, $10::numeric))
insert into posts (business_id, local_date, slot, format, scheduled_at, status, source, brief, caption, variants, media_id)
select $1::uuid, s.local_date, s.slot, 'photo',
       case when $8::post_status = 'ready' then now() + interval '1 day' else now() end,
       $8::post_status, 'manual', $7::jsonb, $5, $6::jsonb, m.id
  from m, s, u1, u2
returning id as post_id, status::text as status, local_date, slot;

parameters.query:
-- #1 post id, #2 results [{platform, account_id, ok, external_id, error}]
with r as (
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb)
    as x(platform text, account_id uuid, ok boolean, external_id text, error text)
), pub as (
  insert into publications (post_id, social_account_id, status, attempts, external_id, error_kind, last_error, published_at)
  select $1::uuid, account_id,
         (case when ok then 'published' else 'failed' end)::pub_status, 1, external_id,
         case when ok then null else 'temporary' end, error, case when ok then now() end
    from r where account_id is not null
  on conflict (post_id, social_account_id) do nothing
  returning id
), up as (
  update posts
     set status = (case when exists (select 1 from r where ok) then 'published' else 'failed' end)::post_status
   where id = $1::uuid
  returning business_id, status
), ev as (
  insert into events (business_id, type, payload)
  select business_id, case when status = 'published' then 'published' else 'publish_failed' end,
         jsonb_build_object('post_id', $1::uuid::text, 'results', $2::jsonb)
    from up
  returning id
)
select $1::uuid as post_id, (select status::text from up) as status,
       (select count(*) from pub) as publications, $2::jsonb as results;

parameters.content:
## Retexia — Photo post (generate + publish)
**Test:** open *Form: new post* → copy the Test URL → *Execute workflow* → fill the form.

Prompt → 1 text call (captions + design brief) → 1 image call (design with all text) → Supabase (media + posts) → Facebook + Instagram → publications.

Edit **Config** for business id, models, image quality, design text language.
Webhook: `POST /webhook/retexia-photo-post` `{"prompt":"...","publish":true,"business_id":"uuid"}`
